title: Explicit native one-K-flat model
statement: Under normalized complex comparisons A [lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-complexes] and supplied ringed closed tensor SB with representative coherence cB, construct a model for the fixed nativeWeilRingedMonoidal b SB [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-structure] on every native K-flat P and arbitrary Q. The model is the fully faithful preimage of the derived equivalence counit, the two exact-functor factors, the explicit middle representative [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-complex-model], and the inverse exact-functor factor for the total. No existence theorem chooses this model. Its naturality is proved separately.
